topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I should have known better, of course. The box was weathered, a silent witness to the years, buried in a part of the garden I hadn’t thought about in ages. I remember the weight of it in my hands, the way the earth clung to its edges, as if reluctant to let it go. I didn’t recall burying it, but that’s not the strange part. It’s the contents that linger in my mind, each item a mute testimony to a time I thought I remembered well. There are photographs, notes—scraps of life I can’t quite place. I find myself drawn to it, yet disturbed, as if I’m intruding on a secret I’m not meant to uncover. I wonder, who was I then, and why did that version of me think this needed hiding?
